answer: Each applicant tends one licensed footbridge across a meadow stream for 120 days. A beacon lamp burns all night, and the keeper logs its oil each morning. Every traveler drops a numbered token into a locked box, and the keeper counts the tokens each Sunday while a neighbor signs the count. Twice a season a warden checks the oil and the token box against the log. A forged count burns the 150 token deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 bridges freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars. A bridge with no lamp is a plank over water, and nobody pays to cross it.
